This script loads the packages used throughout the pipeline and defines a
small set of shared helpers: a number formatter for consistent reporting, and 
the ordering of the ten APNS used to keep figures and tables consistently
ordered across the rest of the repo.

# Libraries

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(skimr)
library(flextable)
library(tidyr)
library(broom)
library(dorothea)
```

# Helpers and constants

`format_num()` formats a numeric value for display in tables: scientific
notation for very small values, three decimal places otherwise.

```{r}
format_num <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x), NA,
    ifelse(abs(x) < 0.001 & x != 0,
           formatC(x, format = "e", digits = 2), # scientific for very small
           formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)))} # fixed 3 decimals otherwise
```

`APNS_ordered` sets the display order of the ten symptom domains, reused
by downstream scripts to keep plots and tables consistent.

```{r}
APNS_ordered <- c("Pain","Avoidance","Reexperience","Hyperarousal",
                  "Anxious","Depression","Somatic","MentalFatigue",
                  "Nightmare","Sleep")

```
